thread:
alice: Quick sync - opened PR to update the Lyra-6B model card. Found: old CLI (`rw model`), SDK uses `model_id=`, benchmarks link points to removed CSV, and the quant note says CPU supported but infra says GPU-only for quant. Can we triage?

bryan: Thanks. I can replace the CLI with the current pattern: `rw models limits update --model lyra-6b --max-tokens 4096`.

celia: On SDK, switch to v2 snippet: `resp = client.text.generate(model="lyra-6b", input=prompt)` and use `resp.output_text` for output. I'll push that.

dev-bot: Note: benchmark artifacts moved to bench.redwood.ai; update href to https://bench.redwood.ai/lyra-6b/v1/report.json.

alice: Also changing compatibility row to: "quantized: GPU supported; CPU quant not supported." Will add a parenthetical about minimum CPU RAM if infra later certifies it.

ci-bot: CI: docs build failed - linkcheck error: /docs/catalog/lyra-6b#benchmarks -> 404

bryan: Updated the CLI snippet, fixed the bench link, and adjusted the quant note. Pushed commit.

celia: Pushed SDK snippet change and updated sample output. Ran `make linkcheck` locally - passes.

ci-bot: CI: re-run queued.

ci-bot: CI: build passed. preview: https://deploy-preview-1410--docs.redwood.ai/catalog/lyra-6b

alice: Preview looks good. Adding a one-line changelog: "docs: lyra-6b - update CLI & SDK examples, fix bench link, clarify quant support". Merging after a quick staging smoke test.

bryan: If infra runs a bench recalculation and numbers change, we'll follow up with a bench-only PR.

celia: I'll open a short SDK migration note linking to this card about `model_id -> model` and `client.generate -> client.text.generate`.

alice: Thanks all.
